rule: A container boundary is an observational quarantine boundary only. It does not imply a distinct ontology, language, grammar, machine, or statistically independent raw source.

nonlocal_evidence_policy.multi_source_mark_results: May support or falsify a law signature, but may not be assigned as local presence to a source catalogue without source-level disaggregation.
nonlocal_evidence_policy.cross_system_results: May not be used to populate local presence unless a source-local component is separately frozen.
nonlocal_evidence_policy.external_canon_lane: May be frozen as validation catalogues but is excluded from the future primary Mark overlap graph.
